change: Functions that bind nothing in their own environments (no parameters, declarations, annex B copies, arguments object or direct eval) skip creating them in AOT Script and module output too, not only in runtime-compiled entries; sloppy functions that never read their receiver skip OrdinaryCallBindThis's conversion (module code is strict, so only the environment rule changes module output).
